full_prompt_en: A square Renaissance-style oil portrait presents a young woman in a black dress with a high white lace collar against a nearly black background. Within the registered image, the selected upper-left portrait has a narrow dark margin around its painted rectangle; the sitter itself is shown from about the waist upward. Her body turns slightly toward the left while her pale face turns back toward the viewer. Brown hair is swept away from the forehead and gathered beneath a white lace headpiece, with a delicate scalloped edge catching the light. Her expression is reserved, lips closed and eyes calmly directed outward. One hand rises to the collar near the chin, lightly touching the elaborate ruff; the other hand rests lower, partly supporting a small cluster of pale flowers near the waist. A small dark earring and ring add restrained points of detail. The black gown has a close-fitted bodice and sleeves densely worked with subtle raised patterns, visible mainly where warm highlights skim the cloth. White lace cuffs repeat the crisp texture of the large collar. The background stays deep and unadorned, letting the lace and skin emerge without a setting or readable text. Carefully blended flesh tones contrast with fine, sharply observed threads along the ruff and headpiece. Soft directional light falls from above and left, brightening the forehead, cheek, hands, and flowers while the far side of the dress disappears into shadow. The overall composition is formal and intimate, balancing pale face and lace against a rich black garment and ground.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形文艺复兴风格油画肖像呈现一名年轻女子，穿黑裙、戴高高的白蕾丝领，背景几乎全黑。在注册图中，选定的左上肖像绘画矩形四周留有窄深色边；人物本身从约腰部向上呈现。身体略向左转，浅色脸庞回望观者。棕发从额前梳离，收在白蕾丝头饰下，精细波浪边承接亮光。她神情保留，嘴唇闭合，目光平静望向外方。一只手抬到下巴附近，轻触繁复的皱领；另一只手较低，部分托住腰边一小簇浅色花。小深色耳饰和戒指带来克制细节。黑裙有贴身上衣与袖子，布满细微凸纹，主要在暖亮光掠过衣料处可见。白蕾丝袖口重复大领子的清晰肌理。背景深暗且无装饰，让蕾丝与皮肤从中浮出，没有场景或可读文字。细致融合的肤色与皱领、头饰上精确观察的细线形成对照。柔和定向光从左上方落下，照亮额头、脸颊、手和花，让衣服另一侧消失在阴影里。整体构图正式而亲密，以浅色面孔和蕾丝平衡浓黑衣服与底面。
style_prompt_en: Renaissance-style oil portraiture sets finely blended warm flesh tones and intricate ivory lace against deep black-brown ground. Small ornamental details remain sharp, while dark cloth is modeled subtly through low-contrast raised patterns and glancing highlights. Edges around focal light planes are controlled; surrounding forms recede softly into shadow. Gentle directional illumination gathers on exposed surfaces and leaves broad dark areas unbroken, creating quiet depth rather than theatrical glare. The close, formal arrangement is restrained, tactile, and dignified.
style_prompt_zh: 文艺复兴风格油画肖像把细致融合的暖肤色与繁复象牙白蕾丝放在深黑棕底面前。小型装饰细节保持清晰，暗色布料则由低反差凸纹和掠过的亮部细微塑形。焦点亮平面周围边缘受控，周围形体柔和退入阴影。温和定向光聚在外露表面，留下大片完整暗区，形成安静纵深而非舞台眩光。近距离正式布局克制、可触而庄严。
theme_en: A young woman in a black dress and white lace collar against darkness
theme_zh: 一位身穿黑裙、戴白蕾丝领的年轻女子立于暗色背景前
name: Sofonisba Anguissola
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
